description: Break the link between the chosen text, objects, table or cells and their style, keeping the current formatting (Break Link to Style in the Paragraph, Character, Object, Table and Cell Styles panel menus). The chosen target is selected first

cells.description: Which cells of the table; omitted means every cell. Give rows and/or columns, or region, or selection: true for the selected cells

region.description: Every row of one region: header, body or footer rows

rows.description: Rows (header rows count) as [first, last] (0-based, inclusive), or [one]

selection.description: Use the selected cells (or the cell holding the text cursor); the table is then the selection's

kind.description: Which kind of style. Give text for paragraph and character styles, target for object styles, table for table styles and cells for cell styles

table.description: Which table. Give frameId, storyId or pageIndex with index (which table, 0-based), or selection: true for the table holding the selection. Add nested to reach a table inside a cell. get_table_info lists every table with its storyId and index

frameId.description: Id of a text frame; index counts the tables in that frame

nested.description: Path to a table nested in cells: each step goes into the cell at (row, column) of the current table and takes its index-th table

column.description: Column of the cell holding the nested table

row.description: Row of the cell holding the nested table

pageIndex.description: 0-based page index; index counts the tables in the page's text frames, frame by frame

selection.description: Use the table holding the selection: selected cells, a text cursor in a cell, or a selected text frame's first table

storyId.description: Story id; index counts the tables in the story

target.description: Which items to act on. Give ids (from list_page_items, or the id a create tool returns), names, or selection: true

names.description: Item names (every item with each name)

text.description: Which text: a text frame by id (the text in the frame, or its whole story), optionally narrowed to a paragraph or character range; or selection: true for the selected text

characters.description: First and last character index within the frame or story (0-based, inclusive)

paragraphs.description: First and last paragraph index within the frame or story (0-based, inclusive)

selection.description: Use the selected text, or the text of the selected text frame

story.description: Use the whole story the frame belongs to, not only the text in the frame

name: break_link_to_style
title: Break Link To Style
